nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the full analyses domain model: TestCatalogEntry (lab test catalogue with CNAM and questionnaire support), Sample (physical specimen with barcode and lifecycle tracking), TestOrder (per-test request with CNAM cost split), and TestResult (technician-entered, biologist-validated result with audit trail).
nodes.languageNotes: All concrete models inherit from BaseModel (UUID PK, soft-delete, timestamps). Uses TextChoices enums for status fields and JSONField for flexible questionnaire storage.

nodes.name: TestCatalogEntry
nodes.summary: Represents a test offered by a laboratory, including code, pricing, fasting requirements, and an ordered JSON list of prerequisite questions asked before sample collection.

nodes.name: Sample
nodes.summary: Represents a physical specimen tied to an appointment; tracks barcode, sample type, collection/reception lifecycle, and the staff who handled each step.

nodes.name: TestOrder
nodes.summary: Represents a request for a specific test on a sample, capturing the frozen CNAM/patient cost split, tube barcode, technician assignment, and snapshotted prerequisite questionnaire answers.

nodes.name: TestResult
nodes.summary: Stores a test result entered by a technician and validated by a biologist; archives original values if the biologist corrects the result for medico-legal traceability.

nodes.name: serializers.py
nodes.summary: Provides DRF serializers for the analyses domain: read/create serializers for Sample (with atomic barcode generation and lab-scope validation), TestOrder (read-only with computed fields), TestResult (with technician and biologist name resolution), and dedicated create/validate serializers for multi-role workflows.

nodes.name: SampleCreateSerializer
nodes.summary: Handles sample creation by nurses or secretaries: validates appointment existence, verifies lab-scope membership, resolves and validates test UUIDs, and atomically creates a Sample with associated TestOrders.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Registers DRF router URLs for CatalogViewSet, SampleViewSet, and OrderViewSet, and adds manual paths for patient-facing results, walk-in, invoice, statistics, and PDF download endpoints.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Implements the complete multi-role analyses API: catalogue management (lab chief), sample collection and reception (nurse/secretary/technician), test result entry and biologist validation, patient result listing, PDF streaming, walk-in patient registration, aggregated lab statistics with role-gated financial data, and invoice generation.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses lazy local imports inside view methods (e.g., notify_*, PatientProfile) to avoid circular imports with other Django apps.

nodes.name: CatalogViewSet
nodes.summary: ModelViewSet for the test catalogue; read access is public-authenticated, write/delete actions require the lab_chief role with 2FA. Scopes querysets to the requesting user's laboratory.

nodes.name: SampleViewSet
nodes.summary: ModelViewSet for specimen management; supports creation by secretary/nurse, and receive/reject custom actions for technicians, each triggering patient notifications via the events module.

nodes.name: OrderViewSet
nodes.summary: Read-only ViewSet for test orders exposing a composite 'result' action that handles GET (fetch), POST (technician entry), and PATCH (biologist validation with optional value correction and archival).

nodes.name: WalkInView
nodes.summary: APIView that atomically registers a walk-in patient: finds or creates the User by phone, creates or updates PatientProfile with CNAM data, creates a confirmed in-lab appointment, a received sample, and per-test orders with frozen CNAM cost splits and questionnaire snapshots.

nodes.name: StatsView
nodes.summary: APIView delivering aggregated lab KPIs over a configurable time window: order counts by status, revenue and CNAM splits (role-gated), daily activity series, top tests by revenue, technician throughput, and low-stock inventory items.

nodes.name: InvoiceView
nodes.summary: APIView that returns a detailed appointment invoice including patient CNAM information, per-test line items with cost splits, and totals; accessible to any 2FA-verified lab staff member.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Provides the shared BaseModel abstract class and ActiveManager used across all apps: UUIDs for external exposure, BigAutoField internal PK, created/updated timestamps, and soft-delete with an active-only queryset manager.
nodes.languageNotes: BaseModel is abstract so it generates no DB table; the ActiveManager is the idiomatic Django pattern for filtering soft-deleted rows transparently.

nodes.name: BaseModel
nodes.summary: Abstract Django model providing UUID primary key exposure, auto-managed created_at/updated_at timestamps, soft-delete via deleted_at, and both full and active-only managers.

nodes.name: ActiveManager
nodes.summary: Custom Django manager that automatically excludes soft-deleted rows (deleted_at is not null) from all querysets.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines inventory management models: InventoryItem (lab reagents, consumables, and equipment with stock level tracking and alert thresholds) and InventoryMovement (auditable signed-delta stock changes applied atomically with SELECT FOR UPDATE to prevent race conditions).
nodes.languageNotes: InventoryMovement.apply() uses SELECT FOR UPDATE inside a transaction to safely update stock without race conditions — a correct pattern for concurrent stock updates.

nodes.name: InventoryItem
nodes.summary: Tracks a single stocked item (reagent, consumable, or equipment) for a laboratory, with current stock, minimum alert threshold, unit cost, and supplier information.

nodes.name: InventoryMovement
nodes.summary: Immutable audit record for a stock change (delivery, consumption, adjustment, expiry), with a signed delta applied atomically via the class method apply(); rejects operations that would produce negative stock.

nodes.name: serializers.py
nodes.summary: DRF serializers for inventory management: read serializer for InventoryItem (exposes computed is_low_stock), create serializer accepting an initial_stock, movement read serializer with actor name, and movement create serializer with sign-consistency validation.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Registers the InventoryItemViewSet under the lab/inventory router prefix.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Implements CRUD for inventory items and stock movement recording; enforces role-based access (lab_chief/technician/biologist for edits, lab_chief only for deletion) and delegates atomic stock updates to InventoryMovement.apply().

nodes.name: InventoryItemViewSet
nodes.summary: ModelViewSet for inventory items with role-gated write access, lab-scoped and filterable querysets (by category, low_stock), and two custom actions: 'movement' for recording stock changes and 'movements' for fetching the movement history.

nodes.name: events.py
nodes.summary: Provides domain-event helper functions that encapsulate notification creation: resolves recipients (patient, assigned nurse, or lab staff by role), formats French-language titles and bodies, and emits Notification records for appointment lifecycle events, sample receipt/rejection, and result entry/validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy intra-module imports inside each helper (e.g., from accounts.models import StaffProfile) prevent circular import errors common in Django multi-app architectures.

nodes.name: notify_appointment_created
nodes.summary: Emits an APPT_CREATED notification to the patient and to all secretary/lab_chief staff of the laboratory when a new appointment is booked.

nodes.name: notify_appointment_status_changed
nodes.summary: Emits a patient-facing notification whose tone and kind adapt to the appointment's new status (confirmed, checked_in, in_progress, completed, cancelled, no_show).

nodes.name: notify_appointment_nurse_assigned
nodes.summary: Notifies both the assigned nurse (new visit details) and the patient (nurse dispatched) when a nurse is assigned to a home-visit appointment.

nodes.name: notify_result_entered
nodes.summary: Notifies all biologists and lab chiefs of a laboratory that a test result has been entered by a technician and is awaiting validation; does not notify the patient at this stage.

nodes.name: notify_result_validated
nodes.summary: Notifies the patient that their validated result is available for PDF download; escalates severity to CRITICAL or WARNING based on the result flag.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Defines the Notification model for transactional user messages with kind, severity, title, body, and an opaque JSON payload for deep-linking; supports polling-based read tracking without requiring WebSockets or push infrastructure.
nodes.languageNotes: Payload stores UUIDs of related objects as JSON rather than generic FKs, keeping the notifications app decoupled from all other domain apps while still enabling client-side deep-links.

nodes.name: Notification
nodes.summary: Transactional notification record addressed to a specific user, carrying kind (event type), severity (UI color), title, body, payload (deep-link data), and read_at for unread badge tracking.

nodes.name: serializers.py
nodes.summary: Provides a read-only NotificationSerializer exposing all fields needed for client display and deep-link navigation.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: Registers explicit URL paths for the four notification actions (mine, unread, mark_read, mark_all_read) without using a DefaultRouter, as the ViewSet exposes only custom actions rather than standard list/create.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Implements read-only notification delivery for the authenticated user: paginated personal notification list with optional unread filter, lightweight unread badge count, and single/bulk mark-as-read actions.

nodes.name: NotificationViewSet
nodes.summary: ViewSet exposing four custom actions for notification management: listing personal notifications with optional unread filter, returning unread count, and marking one or all notifications as read.
